spec_notes: docs/shiploop/spec.md (R-1..R-4) does not contradict the request. It marks two choices as "Default adopted": trimming/blank/control-character rules with 400/404/409 (R-1), and the raw CLI fifth column blank for null (R-3), the latter pinning a format another correct build need not share. It decides without marking: an actual change updates the audit and timestamp, a repeated null is a no-op, notifications are addressed to the agent name and every rapid reassignment is delivered (R-2), filters intersect before pagination (R-3). It is silent on the assignee through transitions, filter exactness/case/repetition, how unassigned shows in list/show, POST/PATCH with assignee, and a bad saved assignee; those are decided in code and the customer documents. It does not state the general "everything keeps working" requirement, and the fix pass's wider changes (rollback on failed save, repeated-filter semantics for status/priority, code-point limits for titles) appear only in fix.md, not the spec.
tests_notes: The new tests are few and broad: TC-1 covers assign, trim, audit actor, updated, no-op, unassign and repeated unassign at once; TC-2 covers all validation, open/in_progress, resolved/closed 409 and 404; TC-5 combines legacy load, restart, CLI table, raw, show and weekly report. Ties to internals: the failed-save test makes the save fail by creating the folder `${dataFile}.${process.pid}.tmp`, a persistence implementation detail; TC-4 calls service.worker.tick() twice; TC-5 matches table spacing `T-0002.*  -  `. Tests that would fail on another correct build: exact error messages ("assignee must be at most 64 characters", "assignee must be valid Unicode text"); TC-1 expects trimming of "  Ada Lovelace  "; TC-4 expects Ada notified twice for A,B,A (a build that dedups the repeat agent's pending notice is acceptable under U-8); repeated filter params must give an empty list; 63 a + one astral character must be accepted; raw fifth column must be empty for unassigned. test/helpers.js was edited (host 127.0.0.1). No test covers PATCH/transition bodies carrying assignee, show of an unassigned ticket, POST/PATCH refusing assignee, or CLI read-only.
maintainer: TicketStore.apply now snapshots and restores the whole store around every persisted write, and assignment notifications are keyed by the audit entry's seq passed into the effects callback; changing either the save path or the audit append order can silently break rollback or notification uniqueness. Listing filters can be a scalar or an array (filterValue/matchesFilters), a shape every new filter must respect, and the CLI uses "-" and "null" markers that are ambiguous with real agent names, documented only in the README.
